channel.title: Nature Communications
channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [6] Homo-metal-element mediated surface modification of sapphire for robust epitaxy of wafer-scale single-crystalline 2D semiconductors
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Lian-Mao Peng, Yanfeng Zhang

Authors: Jialong Wang, Yihao Zheng, Qingsheng Zeng, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Materials growth for wafer-scale 2D semiconductors, a broader relevant topic.

Tags: #2Dmaterials #materialgrowth #semiconductors

Abstract: The wafer-scale growth of 2D transition metal dichalcogenides is desired for their electronic applications. Here, the authors report a surface modification strategy of commercial sapphire substrates to grow wafer-scale monolayer WS2 or MoS2 single crystals, showing their application for high-performance transistors arrays.
